name: Enterprise retrieval and grounded-answer evaluation
description: Compare cited enterprise source IDs with a curated required-source set, compare answerability labels, and aggregate independent reviews of source-grounded answers.

prediction.source_ids.description: Source IDs cited or retrieved for the answer. IDs are deduplicated and compared exactly; no document contents are fetched.

reference.source_ids.description: Curated relevant/required source IDs for the same question. Define corpus snapshot and relevance policy outside this pack.

prediction.answerability.description: Predicted answerability label using the benchmark vocabulary, for example answerable or unanswerable.

reference.answerability.description: Independent answerability label for the specified corpus snapshot; do not infer it from whether the model answered.

human_review.groundedness_score.description: Independent review against the authorized source snapshot, integer 0-4: 0 contradicts sources or invents the central answer; 1 contains major unsupported claims; 2 mixes supported facts with material unsupported content; 3 supports central claims with only minor omissions; 4 supports the complete answer and handles source limits explicitly. Missing source access means no review score, not zero.

metadata.dataset_version.description: Optional immutable dataset/split version for traceability. Not required or verified by this scorer.

metadata.model_version.description: Optional model/checkpoint version that produced the predictions. Not required or verified by this scorer.

human_review.reviewer_id.description: Optional independent reviewer identifier. The scorer does not authenticate the reviewer or validate qualifications; synthetic examples do not identify a real reviewer.

human_review.rubric_version.description: Optional version of the human-review instructions used to assign ratings. The scorer does not verify adherence to that rubric.

metrics.name: Source-ID precision
metrics.description: Mean fraction of predicted source IDs that belong to the curated reference set.
metrics.limitations: Matches supplied IDs only. It does not open sources, verify that a source exists, or establish that a citation supports the answer. This measures ID relevance under the supplied labels, not citation entailment.

metrics.name: Source-ID recall
metrics.description: Mean fraction of curated required source IDs covered by the prediction.
metrics.limitations: Matches supplied IDs only. It does not open sources, verify that a source exists, or establish that a citation supports the answer. Recall does not penalize extra irrelevant sources.

metrics.name: Answerability-label accuracy
metrics.description: Fraction of predicted answerability labels matching the curated label.
metrics.limitations: Labels are corpus- and task-dependent. This is not an independent check that an answer can be supported.

metrics.name: Human-reviewed groundedness
metrics.description: Mean independently reviewed groundedness score normalized from 0-4 to 0-1.
metrics.limitations: This imports an independent review score; the engine neither performs the review nor verifies reviewer identity. Missing reviews are excluded and reduce coverage.

limitations: This is a reusable evaluation template, not an official benchmark scorer. All targets are unset; calibrate thresholds and minimum coverage on a representative held-out dataset. Scores are not automatically used as screening gates or RL rewards.
Source-ID overlap does not prove a statement is supported; it is deliberately separate from human-reviewed groundedness.
Corpus permissions, document freshness, relevance judgments, and answerability labels must be maintained by the dataset owner.
This does not reproduce ALCE's entailment-based citation evaluation. All fixture documents and annotations are fictional.
Unused metadata and review-provenance fields are optional traceability suggestions; their presence, authenticity, and types are not validated unless a metric references them.
